title: Lost Highway: Why would Renee even marry Fred?

commenti.body:
I don't think she "gets off on snuff films." I think that version of her existed only in Fred's mind because he was unable to accept that he killed her. She does seem scared of him, which is saying something if she actually did have a past with gangsters and pornographers.

The film can't be taken literally, the photo with both Arquettes proves this.

She may have been cheating on him, she may have been out doing something else but lied about it. This film is about the wild, jealous imagination of men... remember that it was inspired by OJ and the murder of Nicole Simpson

That's basically how I see it as well. I do think she has a past which is why she's nervous about the videotapes. 

Good point about OJ/Nicole. Not only is she afraid of him, but she still shows him some bit of tenderness (the "back pat", when he tells her about the dream). It just doesn't seem consistent with the porn party scene at Andy's.

The thing that confuses me is this quote from Lynch himself (re: Renee): "“But why though? Because of this person. This woman. No matter which place you first start walking, eventually you’re going to walk into trouble – if you’re walking with the wrong person.” That seems to be as close to confirmation as any that he thinks Renee is bad.
It's a weird quote, I guess. It seems out of context at best, though. Lynch relies on his unconscious mind to write and weird stuff dwells in that brainspace.
I don’t see it as him saying she’s “bad” just that they’re bad together

They're clearly not in a healthy relationship.

That line, "At least I can still make you laugh" got a bunch of awkward laughter when I saw it in the theater last year.

Outside the theater, I overheard someone talking about how they haven't seen many Lynch films and weren't sure they were in on the jokes.
There’s definitely a lot of humor in his work if you like absurdism
There's a lot to laugh at even if ain't funny.
You’re not wrong, but if it makes me laugh it’s funny

Lost Highway is probably the funniest Lynch movie. Those cops who come to look at Fred & Renee's house are basically a comedy skit. And some of the stuff with Richard Pryor and Jack Nance at the garage.

She met a semi-famous jazz musician and fell in love.  There's nothing unusual about that.  He was rich and had a stable life, both things that would have seemed appealing.

The relationship got boring.  She started cheating, so she was always uncomfortable around him because she was afraid of what would happen if he found out.  Then, he found out, maybe about the cheating but probably about the porn, since it was something he saw on videotape.

It's unlikely that she was ever in love with Dick Laurent.  I think you might be taking the sinister edge of her character a little too literally.  For half the movie, she's sort of filling the role of a demon sent to torture Fred for the murder of his wife, but that doesn't mean that the real Renee was some kind of immoral monster.

Fun fact: the heavy one, Louis Eppolito, was convicted of multiple murders a few years later. He had been working for the mob as a hit man for years and tried to make a go of it in Hollywood as a screen writer and actor after retirement.

He was an amazingly bad actor in the film despite being a real cop.
